items.summary: Complete with un/une/le/la/de; contracted articles box; circle du/de la/de l'.
Noun groups with de, match jouer à + games, à la/au/aux body aches, circle articles.
Unit 13 Bilan: classify nouns by gender/number, plurals and articles in texts.
Adjective chapter opener: feminine in -e; tick masculine/feminine, circle correct agreement.
Give masculine adjectives, rewrite text in feminine, other feminine endings, woman or man.
Circle masculine/feminine adjectives, give feminine forms, agree adjectives in brackets.
Irregular feminine adjectives: match, circle, choose Il est/Elle est, rewrite in feminine.
Plural of adjectives box; underline plural adjectives and give plural forms.
Circle agreeing adjectives, agree adjectives in plural, -al/-aux plurals.
Plural of -al adjectives, listening on plural pronunciation, match subjects to adjectives.
Colour adjectives box; circle invariable colours, agree adjectives, tick gender and number.
Match subjects to adjectives; adjective position box; listen: adjective before or after noun.
Say if adjectives go before/after noun, reorder words into sentences, place adjectives.
Place prochain/dernier correctly; possessive adjectives box; circle mon/ma, ton/ta, son/sa.
Match possessives to nouns, complete with notre/nos/votre/vos, make sentences with son/leur.
